type Json = string | number | boolean | null | Json[] | { [k: string]: Json };
const a: Json = [1, ["x", [undefined]]];
const b: Json = { k: { m: () => 1 } };
type Nested<T> = T | Nested<T>[];
const c: Nested<number> = [1, ["2"]];
function depth(v: Json): number { return Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(depth).join() : 0; }
type L = L[] | number;
const d: L[] = [1, [2, ["3"]]];
function count(v: Json[]): string { return v.map((x) => 1).length; }
const e: L = [[undefined]];
type O = { [k: string]: O | number };
const o: O = { k: { m: "s" } };
type P<X, Y> = X | Y | P<Y, X>[];
const p: P<number, string> = [1, ["a", [true]]];
type G<T> = T | G<T[]>[];
const g1: G<number> = [[1]];
const g2: G<number> = ["x"];
